activity_summary: You came out by the south porch still carrying the last chord of Morley's four-part anthem, and Mistress Ansell said your name twice before you answered. Sir John Spencer went ahead without sword-bearer or halberds and looked at nobody. Master Thwaite had reached the second of the four last things. You spoke to none of Spencer's party, and you went home when she told you dinner would not wait.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered on the second naming, and left the line to follow him home.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Said his name twice, and took him out of the wind.

entities.name: Thomas Morley
entities.context: Named the four parts, and told him a song is not a sermon.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Said he had reached the second of the four last things, and sent them to eat.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Passed out of his pew without sword-bearer or halberds, and looked at nobody.

facets.activity: Heard Mistress Ansell say the name a second time

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Are you unwell, or only a poet?

quotes.speaker: thomas_morley
quotes.text: Four parts. The boys held the close of it, which is more than a cold church usually allows a treble.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: I began upon the four last things. I reached the second.
